articles.topic: Gut bacteria transplants peanut allergy tolerance
articles.headline: Frozen Poop Pills Just Rewired Food Allergies in Humans
articles.body: Researchers at Boston Children's Hospital gave adults with severe peanut allergies frozen capsules containing healthy gut bacteria from non-allergic donors. After a single treatment of 36 pills, six out of 15 participants showed dramatically improved tolerance four months later, able to eat multiple peanuts without reaction. The breakthrough opens a new path for treating one of the hardest allergies to crack. The study reveals how gut bacteria and their metabolites work with your immune system to influence whether your body accepts or rejects food.
articles.takeaway: A single fecal microbiota transplant can shift your immune tolerance to peanuts—proof that your gut bacteria directly control food allergies.

articles.topic: Heart muscle regeneration after myocardial infarction
articles.headline: Your Heart Can Actually Regrow Muscle. Here's What Scientists Just Proved.
articles.body: For decades, cardiologists treated heart attacks as permanent: muscle dies, scar tissue forms, function is lost forever. New research from University of Sydney proves that's wrong. Using living human heart tissue, researchers showed that heart muscle cells actually do re-enter the cell cycle and divide after a heart attack. The regeneration is limited—it doesn't repair full damage—but it fundamentally overturns the idea that damaged hearts are incapable of self-repair. This opens the door to boosting natural repair mechanisms.
articles.takeaway: Your heart has intrinsic regenerative capacity after a heart attack. The next step is learning to amplify it.

articles.topic: Pet interaction emotional wellbeing real-time daily stress
articles.headline: Petting Your Dog Actually Changes Your Mood Right Now
articles.body: A study of 188 dog and cat owners wearing experience-sampling devices found that momentary interaction with pets was directly linked to higher positive mood and lower negative mood in real time. Researchers tracked participants up to 10 times per day over five days and found the emotional lift was consistent and significant. Interacting with dogs and cats produced similar benefits, though cats showed a curious pattern with event-related stress. The bottom line: petting a companion animal isn't placebo—it measurably shifts your emotional state in the moment.
articles.takeaway: Pet interaction boosts your positive affect and reduces negative affect immediately, independent of breed or species.

articles.topic: Daily steps cardiovascular mortality risk reduction
articles.headline: Your Steps Actually Count. Even On Your Sitting Days.
articles.body: Researchers tracking over 70,000 adults for seven years found something counterintuitive: the amount you sit doesn't erase the benefits of daily movement. Any step count above 2,200 steps per day was linked to lower risk of death and cardiovascular disease, regardless of sitting time. The finding removes the excuse that a desk job cancels out your walks. What matters is consistency—not the perfect workout, just movement that accumulates across your day. Even on your busiest days, those steps still count toward longevity.
articles.takeaway: 2,200 steps daily is the threshold where mortality risk drops, even if you sit for hours afterward.

workout.title: Dumbbell Density Block: Superset Circuit for Strength & Fat Loss
workout.tip: Perform all sets of Superset A before moving to Superset B—this allows adequate recovery for heavier weights while keeping heart rate elevated.
workout.warmup: 5 min: 10 jumping jacks, 10 inchworms, 10 kettlebell swings (bodyweight simulation with arms), 10 reverse lunges each leg, 5 push-ups

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thrusters (Superset A)
exercises.notes: Squat, then explosively press dumbbells overhead. Requires full-body coordination and metabolic demand. Rest 30 sec between sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Renegade Rows (Superset A)
exercises.notes: In plank position, row one dumbbell to hip while maintaining core stability. Builds pressing-position strength and anti-rotation core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges (Superset B)
exercises.notes: Step forward with load at shoulders or sides, keep torso upright. Single-leg work builds unilateral strength and hip stability.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press (Superset B)
exercises.notes: Lying on back, press dumbbells from floor, elbows graze floor at bottom. Range of motion is reduced, allowing heavier load and joint safety.

exercises.name: Dumbbell High Pulls
exercises.notes: Pull dumbbells high to shoulder height, elbows lead the movement. Explosive triple-extension movement preps athletes for Hyrox and OCR.

workout.cooldown: 4 min: shoulder rolls backward 10 reps, standing quad stretch 20 sec each leg, standing quad stretch 20 sec each leg, torso rotation 10 each side
workout.description: High-volume superset circuit using dumbbells to build strength endurance and metabolic stress in 45 minutes. Perfect for time-crunched athletes training for Hyrox and fat loss who need compound movements paired for maximum output.
